statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count actual induced nine-vertex rook subsets once by their vertex sets and put d_T=6-r_T for each actual triangle, where r_T counts the rooks containing T. If R=227 and every d_T belongs to {0,1,2}, then it is impossible that exactly seven actual triangles have deficiency two. Equivalently, the positive family cannot consist of ten d1 and seven d2 triangles with every other d_T zero. The maximum-deficiency-two condition is an explicit hypothesis; this does not exclude other R227 populations or resolve the target.
